# MediaPipe Tasks Vision

Used by `js/tryon.js` to find the face and the hair in a visitor's photo, on
their own device.

- `vision_bundle.mjs`, `wasm/`: `@mediapipe/tasks-vision` 0.10.21 (Apache-2.0)
- `face_landmarker.task`: MediaPipe Face Landmarker, float16 v1 (Apache-2.0)
- `hair_segmenter.tflite`: MediaPipe Hair Segmenter, float32 (Apache-2.0)

Source: https://ai.google.dev/edge/mediapipe
